1	import { type QueryClient, useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
2	import type { CurrencyCode } from 'api/generated/standardMetricsInternalAPI.schemas'
3	import type { DatumCategorySection, DatumToCreate } from 'pages/metrics-repository/types'
4	import { deepClone } from 'pages/metrics-repository/utils'
5	import { Category, CategoryTypeMapping, type ReportingCadence } from 'pages/portfolio-company/types'
6	import { getMetricDate } from 'pages/portfolio-company/utils'
7	import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react'
8	import { ValueType } from 'types'
9	import { api } from 'utils/api'
10	import { toast } from '@/components/legacy/components/toast'
11	
12	/**
13	 * Helper function to determine the correct value_type and inputUnit based on category
14	 */
15	export const getValueTypeAndInputUnit = (categoryId: number, customCategoryType?: number | null) => {
16	  const isCustomCategory = !Object.values(Category).includes(categoryId as Category)
17	  const valueType = isCustomCategory ? customCategoryType : CategoryTypeMapping[categoryId as Category]
18	
19	  return {
20	    value_type: valueType,
21	    inputUnit: valueType,
22	  }
23	}
24	
25	const useMetricsTableCrud = ({
26	  companySlug,
27	  reportingCadence,
28	  fiscalYearEndDate,
29	  queryClient,
30	  sections,
31	  setSections,
32	}: {
33	  companySlug: string
34	  reportingCadence: ReportingCadence
35	  fiscalYearEndDate: Date
36	  startDate: Date
37	  endDate: Date
38	  queryClient: QueryClient
39	  sections: DatumCategorySection[]
40	  setSections: Dispatch<SetStateAction<DatumCategorySection[]>>
41	}) => {
42	  const { mutate: createNewMetricMutation, isPending: isCreatingMetric } = useMutation({
43	    mutationFn: ({
44	      value,
45	      currency,
46	      datum_category,
47	      category,
48	      metricName,
49	      inputUnit,
50	      date,
51	      isGlobal,
52	    }: {
53	      date: string
54	      value: string
55	      currency?: CurrencyCode
56	      datum_category: number
57	      category: number
58	      metricName: string
59	      inputUnit?: ValueType
60	      isGlobal: boolean
61	    }) =>
62	      api.POST({
63	        url: `/company/${companySlug}/metric/`,
64	        body: [
65	          {
66	            metric_cadence: reportingCadence,
67	            value: !isGlobal && inputUnit === ValueType.STRING ? value : value.replace(/,/g, ''),
68	            category: isGlobal ? category : Category.CUSTOM,
69	            custom_category_name: isGlobal ? '' : metricName,
70	            custom_category_type: isGlobal ? null : inputUnit,
71	            datum_category,
72	            currency,
73	            date: getMetricDate(reportingCadence, date.trim().replace('FY', ''), fiscalYearEndDate),
74	          },
75	        ],
76	      }),
77	    onSuccess: (newlyCreatedDatums: Array<any>) => {
78	      // Add the newly created datum to the state
79	      if (newlyCreatedDatums.length > 0) {
80	        const newlyCreatedDatum = newlyCreatedDatums[0] // Single metric creation returns array with one item
81	
82	        setSections((prevSections) => {
83	          const newSections = prevSections.map((section) => ({
84	            ...section,
85	            displayed_categories: section.displayed_categories.map((displayedCategory) => {
86	              // Check if the newly created datum belongs to this category
87	              if (newlyCreatedDatum.datum_category === displayedCategory.category.id) {
88	                // Add the newly created datum to this category
89	                const newDatumValue = {
90	                  ...newlyCreatedDatum,
91	                  ...getValueTypeAndInputUnit(displayedCategory.category.id, newlyCreatedDatum.custom_category_type),
92	                }
93	
94	                return {
95	                  ...displayedCategory,
96	                  category: {
97	                    ...displayedCategory.category,
98	                    datum_values: [...displayedCategory.category.datum_values, newDatumValue],
99	                  },
100	                }
101	              }
102	              return displayedCategory
103	            }),
104	          }))
105	          return newSections
106	        })
107	      }
108	    },
109	    onError: (err) => {
110	      if (err) toast.error('Failed to create new metric')
111	    },
112	  })
113	
114	  const { mutate: updateMetricMutation, isPending: isUpdatingMetric } = useMutation({
115	    mutationFn: ({ metricId, value, currency }: { metricId: number; value: string; currency?: CurrencyCode }) =>
116	      api.PATCH({
117	        url: `/company/${companySlug}/metric/${metricId}/`,
118	        body: { value: value.replace(/,/g, '') || null, currency },
119	      }),
120	    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
121	      const { metricId, value, currency } = variables
122	      const cleanedValue = value.replace(/,/g, '') || null
123	
124	      // Update the metric value after successful server response
125	      const newSections = sections.map((section) => ({
126	        ...section,
127	        displayed_categories: section.displayed_categories.map((displayedCategory) => ({
128	          ...displayedCategory,
129	          category: {
130	            ...displayedCategory.category,
131	            datum_values: displayedCategory.category.datum_values.map((datumValue) =>
132	              datumValue.id === metricId
133	                ? {
134	                    ...datumValue,
135	                    value: cleanedValue,
136	                    source_value: cleanedValue,
137	                    currency: currency || datumValue.currency,
138	                    source_currency: currency || datumValue.source_currency,
139	                  }
140	                : datumValue,
141	            ),
142	          },
143	        })),
144	      }))
145	
146	      setSections(newSections)
147	    },
148	
149	    onError: (err) => {
150	      if (err) toast.error('Failed to update metric')
151	    },
152	  })
153	
154	  const { mutate: bulkUpdateDatumsMutation } = useMutation({
155	    mutationFn: ({ datums }: { datums: Record<string, string> }) => {
156	      // Only make the API call if there are datums to update
157	      if (Object.keys(datums).length === 0) {
158	        return Promise.resolve([]) // Return empty response if no datums
159	      }
160	
161	      return api.PATCH({
162	        url: `/company/${companySlug}/bulk-update-metrics/`,
163	        body: Object.entries(datums).map(([id, value]) => ({
164	          id: Number(id),
165	          value,
166	        })),
167	      })
168	    },
169	    onMutate: async ({ datums }) => {
170	      // Cancel any outgoing refetches
171	      await queryClient.cancelQueries({
172	        queryKey: ['datum-category-view-group'],
173	      })
174	
175	      // Snapshot the previous value
176	      const previousSections = deepClone(sections)
177	
178	      // Optimistically update all the metric values
179	      const newSections = sections.map((section) => ({
180	        ...section,
181	        displayed_categories: section.displayed_categories.map((displayedCategory) => ({
182	          ...displayedCategory,
183	          category: {
184	            ...displayedCategory.category,
185	            datum_values: displayedCategory.category.datum_values.map((datumValue) => {
186	              const metricId = datumValue.id.toString()
187	              if (metricId in datums) {
188	                const cleanedValue = datums[metricId].replace(/,/g, '') || null
189	                return {
190	                  ...datumValue,
191	                  value: cleanedValue,
192	                  source_value: cleanedValue,
193	                }
194	              }
195	              return datumValue
196	            }),
197	          },
198	        })),
199	      }))
200	
201	      setSections(newSections)
202	      return { previousSections } // Return context for rollback
203	    },
204	    onError: (err, _variables, context) => {
205	      // Revert state on error
206	      if (context?.previousSections) {
207	        setSections(context.previousSections)
208	      }
209	      if (err) toast.error('Failed to update metrics')
210	    },
211	  })
212	
213	  const { mutate: bulkCreateDatumsMutation } = useMutation({
214	    mutationFn: ({ datums }: { datums: Array<DatumToCreate> }) =>
215	      api.POST({
216	        url: `/company/${companySlug}/metric/`,
217	        body: datums,
218	      }),
219	
220	    onSuccess: (newlyCreatedDatums: Array<any>) => {
221	      // Add newly created datums to the state
222	      setSections((prevSections) => {
223	        const newSections = prevSections.map((section) => ({
224	          ...section,
225	          displayed_categories: section.displayed_categories.map((displayedCategory) => {
226	            // Check if any of the newly created datums belong to this category
227	            const relevantCreatedDatums = newlyCreatedDatums.filter(
228	              (createdDatum) => createdDatum.datum_category === displayedCategory.category.id,
229	            )
230	
231	            if (relevantCreatedDatums.length > 0) {
232	              // Add the newly created datums to this category
233	              const newDatumValues = relevantCreatedDatums.map((createdDatum) => ({
234	                ...createdDatum,
235	                ...getValueTypeAndInputUnit(displayedCategory.category.id, createdDatum.custom_category_type),
236	              }))
237	
238	              return {
239	                ...displayedCategory,
240	                category: {
241	                  ...displayedCategory.category,
242	                  datum_values: [...displayedCategory.category.datum_values, ...newDatumValues],
243	                },
244	              }
245	            }
246	            return displayedCategory
247	          }),
248	        }))
249	        return newSections
250	      })
251	    },
252	    onError: (err) => {
253	      if (err) toast.error('Failed to create metrics')
254	    },
255	  })
256	
257	  return {
258	    createNewMetricMutation,
259	    updateMetricMutation,
260	    bulkCreateDatumsMutation,
261	    bulkUpdateDatumsMutation,
262	    isLoading: isUpdatingMetric || isCreatingMetric,
263	  }
264	}
265	
266	export default useMetricsTableCrud
